description: Live Google or Bing position (top 20) of a website for up to 5 keywords on Google or 10 on Bing, with the ranking URL and the top 3 domains. Use to check right now where a site ranks on Google (default) or Bing (engine: bing; ChatGPT search and Copilot draw on Bing's index) for specific keywords (one country). Returns engine, ranking count and results[] {keyword, position (null when not in the top 20), unchecked (true when Google gave no normal page, so there is no position), url, title, top3[] domains}. Not charged when the data source fails. Price: $0.10 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

keywords.description: Keywords to check: 1-5 on Google, 1-10 on Bing

name: seo_rank

ranking.description: Keywords where the site is in the top results

list.description: Every organic result that was read, in order

site.description: Site of the result; empty when it could not be read

position.description: null when not in the top results

seen.description: Organic results the search engine returned for this keyword; the site was looked for in these

unchecked.description: True when Google gave no normal results page for this keyword, so there is no position to report (null does not mean 'not ranking' here)

wrapped.description: Results Google served behind its own link; above 0 the order may differ from a normal search

title: Google or Bing rank check
